First project-side statement on the crashing path that consumes the fuzzer-supplied buffer and length by materializing them into `struct buffer b`.

When called for `"true"`, `sizeof("true")` is 5, so this line decrements `len` to 4 and then adds 3 to the caller cursor. For the witness, the caller cursor already equals `ue`, so `*ucp` becomes `ue + 3`. The fix adds `if (*ucp > ue) *ucp = ue;` immediately after this line.
